pages.text: Converts a value to a YAML document.$(br2)The document uses block style with two spaces indentation. If $(1)value$() is a single variable with a yaml tag, the value is placed at the path of the tag.
$(li)$(1)value$() any type: the value to convert$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the YAML document
$(1)CALL c0de/strings/TO_YAML$(br)  PARAMETER value config ;$(br)  RESULT result yaml$()
